info.title: Onyx query API
info.summary: Data rows with proofs, level-2 observations, level-3 signed facts, level-5 track records and data proposals.
info.description: Testnet only. Every row comes with a Merkle proof and a `verify` bundle so a client checks it against the root on its own node, never trusting the server (docs/spec/delivery.md). Paid routes use x402 v2 with testnet USDC on Base Sepolia. A hosted test node answers at https://onyx.cryptagraph.com (payments not switched on).

servers.description: The hosted testnet node (Base Sepolia; payments off).

get.description: Always free and `no-store`. Roots, payments, receipts, settles, indexer, level-3 post log, shard levels and serving checks.
docs/api/openapi.json as compiled into this build (OpenAPI 3.1). Free; revalidate with If-None-Match.
Capped by rows and bytes (413 `export_too_large`). Free exports are rate limited per client.

get.summary: An estimate, apart from checked values
get.description: A value Onyx did not check (ADR-0050, docs/spec/estimates.md): a model's output or an interpolation, with its method (id and hash) and its error band (`unknown` included, never left out). Its level is `E`, not a rung of the proof ladder: `proofLevel` and `ladder` are always null, and no checked route, total or market serves an estimate. Only `estimate.` metrics answer here; any other metric is 404 `unknown_metric`. Free on testnet.

get.summary: One address in a salted label set
get.description: Each membership of the address as a salted row with its own salt and proof (ADR-0037 amendment 2). Testnet: only `test.*` sets are served until label rights are cleared. Free (30 a minute), `no-store`. A 404 `no_label_row` is the server word, not a proof.

get.summary: A metric's row for one subject
get.description: The row keyed `subject` in the newest finalized shard of `metric` within `min_as_of..as_of` (at most 16 shards searched). Not for settling money: use `/v1/settlement`.

get.summary: A level-2 value with its round
get.description: Several bonded observers fetched the source in one window with sealed answers. Priced like a row; every answer carries `limits`.

202.description: No round settled this subject yet and a prepaid hold paid for one (ADR-0049), or another buyer's round for it is queued. Poll the ticket.

get.summary: Rounds of a fact that settled no value
get.description: Free (30 a minute per client). 409 `settled_value` once the fact has a value: ask the paid route with `outcome=all`.

The state of a round a prepaid hold paid for (ADR-0049, docs/spec/paid-observation.md). Once `observed`, the paid answer is in `observation` (the same body as `/v1/observations`); once `released`, the hold was dropped and nothing was charged. Free; never cached.
One row of a finalized shard, its Merkle proof, the root and the `verify` bundle. Priced per row (x402).
Free; a hint for a client that re-runs the check. 404 `no_serving_check` without a check for the metric.

get.summary: A market's value, ready for a contract
get.description: The market's row from its pinned shard, with the calldata shape `OnyxSettlement.verifyRow` takes. Level-2 shards are refused (409 `proof_level_not_accepted`).
Mounted only with a signed book. Free (30 a minute), `no-store`, never settles money.

post.summary: Record a data proposal for review
post.description: Records an accepted or held proposal and returns a receipt. Not verification and not publication (ADR-0039). Do not retry a timed-out POST automatically: check the receipt first.
Validates and routes a proposal; for a rights-cleared level-2 source it pulls the endpoint once and previews the value. Records nothing.

get.description: Public status only, `no-store`. Adds `check` once an approved proposal was fed to the observers.
Level 5. Free, never priced. 1,024 records a page.
Head, or with `at` and `from`/`posts` a page of a chained log (format 2). 2 heads and 60 pages a minute per client.
The registry the latest commitment names (Borsh `RegistryData`). No query.

get.summary: One source's track record on a metric
get.description: Rows under Merkle proofs; `since` chains from a commitment you checked.

get.summary: A page of a record's history
get.description: `at` (the latest commitment) and `from`, in this order.

The bounty board: coarse categories of wanted data (kind, domain, region, cadence), each shown only once at least minAccounts prepaid accounts want it, as a bucket. Never an exact query. Changes only at the weekly cut.

post.description: Four values from closed lists, signed by an open prepaid deposit for this week (read on chain, never charged). Any other field is refused (bounty_too_specific). The account is kept only as a salted hash.

200.description: Taken; it counts from the next cut

new.description: False when the account already held this category (renewed).

Address.description: An EVM address, `0x` and 40 hex digits.

items.description: A round that settled no value; sealed (`revealed` instead of `reveals`) until the fact is closed.

limits.description: Known limits of level 2 (docs/spec/delivery.md#level-2-limits). Advisory: not authenticated.

Error.description: Every error. Some carry fields beside `error` (`limits` on a level-2 402, `route` on a refused submission, `reason` on track and signed refusals, `last` and `price` on a `prepaid_refused` with the wrong total).

servingCheck.description: The serving check that cleared the row (ADR-0034 Amendment 1): only on a gated metric.

proofLevel.description: The value's proof level (1 recomputed, 2 re-observed, 3 source-proven, 4 claim, 5 track record): its ladder's top (ADR-0048).

oneOf.description: The chain indexer's cursor and shards (ADR-0033).
The level-3 post log (ROADMAP C62); docs/spec/delivery.md lists its fields.

shardLevels.description: Shards served per proof level, e.g. `{"1": 2}`.

oneOf.description: Paid observation tickets (ADR-0049): queued, running, observed, released, unbilled, oldestQueuedSecs.

Hex.description: Bytes as `0x` and lowercase hex (Borsh bytes where the field says so).

LabelRows.description: Every membership of one address in one salted set; never another row salt.

Limits.description: Known limits of level 2 (docs/spec/delivery.md#level-2-limits). Advisory: not authenticated.

finalizedAt.description: Block height (on chain) or ledger step (off chain) of finalization.

oneOf.description: Unix time the shard's snapshot ends, when the source has one.

servingCheck.description: The serving check that cleared the row (ADR-0034 Amendment 1): only on a gated metric.

proofLevel.description: The value's proof level (1 recomputed, 2 re-observed, 3 source-proven, 4 claim, 5 track record): its ladder's top (ADR-0048).

sealed.description: Sealed reveals (ROADMAP C11); only for a keyed draw.

value.description: The answer as decimal text at the feed's scale.

oneOf.description: The `OnyxRegistry` calls a client makes on its own node.

limits.description: Known limits of level 2 (docs/spec/delivery.md#level-2-limits). Advisory: not authenticated.

items.description: A published round of the same fact that settled no value (`outcome=all` only).

Observation.description: A level-2 value with its round's public transcript (ADR-0027). Check it with `client::verify_observation` and your OWN copy of the feed template.

value.description: The value the observers agreed on, as the feed's decimal text: what the source published, not a claim that it is correct.

check.description: Only once an approved submission was fed to the observers (ADR-0039 amendment 1).

ReceiptStatus.description: Public status only: never the proposal or reviewer notes.

Route.description: Where a proposal goes and why.

finalizedAt.description: Block height (on chain) or ledger step (off chain) of finalization.

oneOf.description: Unix time the shard's snapshot ends, when the source has one.

servingCheck.description: The serving check that cleared the row (ADR-0034 Amendment 1): only on a gated metric.

proofLevel.description: The value's proof level (1 recomputed, 2 re-observed, 3 source-proven, 4 claim, 5 track record): its ladder's top (ADR-0048).

Row.description: One row of a finalized shard with its Merkle proof.

SaltedAnswer.description: One bought row of a format-3 (salted) label set: the set header, the row (`borsh(membership) || salt`) and its proof. Check it with `onyx_labels::salted::verify_salted_answer` against the content hash YOU pinned, never the `contentHash` it carries.

Served.description: Shards a serving check cleared, in snapshot order. A hint only: the client re-runs the check.

proofLevel.description: The value's proof level (1 recomputed, 2 re-observed, 3 source-proven, 4 claim, 5 track record): its ladder's top (ADR-0048).

Settlement.description: A value a contract can verify: the same payload passes `OnyxSettlement.verifyRow` and `OnyxMerkle.verify`.

SignedFact.description: A level-3 signed report (docs/spec/proof-ladder.md R-SIG-ON-7): `level` 3, `payload`, `signature`, `reportHash`, `valueHash`, `acceptedAt`, `ladder` (its one step at level 3 on `reportHash`, at `acceptedAt`, from `OnyxSignedBook.ReportRecorded`; ADR-0048 amendment 2), `checkedAt` {block, blockHash, blockTime}, `book`, `chainId`, `verifyCall`, `moneySettlement`. Check it with `OnyxSignedBook.settleable(fact)` on your own node.

sourceUrl.description: https only (empty for own data with a payload).

keyProof.description: `{prover, real, responseKeccak256?, responseBytes?, proof?}`; the stub prover is refused as not real.

Submission.description: A data proposal (ADR-0038, docs/spec/submissions.md). At most 64 KiB. No personal contact data.

TrackHistory.description: `{level: 5, source, metric, commitmentHash, from, entries[{row, proof}], before, after}`.

TrackLog.description: The publication logs: format 1 `{level, example, asOf, commitmentHash, links, statements, resolutions, intake}`; format 2 head `{..., format: 2, links, rows, pageRows, intake}` or a page `{level, commitmentHash, since, from, rows}` / `{level, commitmentHash, from, posts}`.

TrackRecord.description: `{level: 5, example, source, metric, asOf, commitmentHash, commitment, params, record{row, proof}, summary{row, proof}, history, chain}`; Borsh rows under Merkle proofs. Check with `onyx_track::wire::check_record_body`.

VerifyBundle.description: What a client needs to check the row on its own node: recompute the shard id and the binding, then call `getFinalizedRoot(round, shard)` at block tag `finalized` (docs/spec/delivery.md, Verification).

Ladder.description: The value's proof level and the rises that got it there, oldest first (ADR-0048, docs/spec/delivery.md "Ladder"). Each step is strictly stronger than the one before; a client trusts a step only through its lane's own check and refuses a ladder that falls, rewrites a step it saw before, or states a level its steps do not reach.

value.description: `keccak256("onyx-ladder-value-v1" ‖ key ‖ value hash)`: the one value the ladder is about (never the value itself).

evidence.description: What the lane's check verifies: a shard root, a level-2 result hash or a level-3 report hash.

at.description: Unix time the proof was settled, as its lane binds it (a row's is the server's finalizedUnix hint).

record.description: The chain record that made the step public.

steps.description: One to five steps (one per level at most).

ObserveAccepted.description: 202 on a level-2 subject no round settled yet (ADR-0049): to the payer, the ticket (shown once); to anyone else while the fact's round is queued or running, the state only. Nothing is charged until the round is served.

deadline.description: Unix time the hold is released if the round is not final.

Ticket.description: A paid observation ticket (ADR-0049). `observation` once observed (the paid answer); `refund` once released (nothing was charged).

Estimate.description: An estimate (ADR-0050): not checked, never a proof level, never part of a checked total.

minAccounts.description: A category is shown only with wants from at least this many prepaid accounts.

week.description: Weeks since 1970-01-01 00:00 UTC; the board changes only at each week's cut.

nextCut.description: Unix time of the next cut.

signature.description: EIP-191 signature of the want text for this week: onyx-want-v1, then kind=, domain=, region=, cadence= and week= lines.

round.name: round
round.description: Decimal round, no sign or leading zeros (other spellings: 308).

root.name: root
root.description: Pin the root: the answer is `immutable` only when it matches (409 `root_mismatch` otherwise).

min_as_of.name: min_as_of
min_as_of.description: Your freshness floor: nothing older is served, and a miss is a 404 before any 402.

obs_as_of.name: as_of
obs_as_of.description: Newest round whose window ends at or before it; not with `window_end`.

outcome.name: outcome
outcome.description: `all` adds the rounds that settled no value.

since.name: since
since.description: A commitment you checked before: the answer chains from it.

contributor.name: ONYX-CONTRIBUTOR
contributor.description: Contributor pass (ADR-0025): fresh data discounted, answered `private`. GET only.

payment.name: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE
payment.description: x402 v2 payment payload (base64 JSON), answering a 402. GET only.

prepaid.name: ONYX-PREPAID-VOUCHER
prepaid.description: Prepaid voucher instead of an x402 payment (ROADMAP S7, ADR-0046 amendment 1): `0x<buyer>:<cumulative>:0x<65-byte signature>`, the buyer's EIP-712 signature of its running total, which must be the last total the server took plus this answer's price. Only on servers that take prepaid balances. GET only.

ifNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
ifNoneMatch.description: Free answers only: a match is a 304.

address.name: address
address.description: A namespaced address, 1 to 128 visible ASCII characters.

ticket.name: ticket
ticket.description: The ticket a paid observation hold returned (64 hex digits); the bearer's secret.

est_subject.name: subject
est_subject.description: The subject's text, as `/v1/observations` takes it.

ONYX-PREPAID-RESPONSE.description: An answer paid with a prepaid voucher: `total=<cumulative>; spendable=<left>`.

Redirect.description: 308 to the one canonical spelling of the URL.

PaymentRequired.description: 402 `payment_required` with an x402 offer in `PAYMENT-REQUIRED`, or `payment_failed` with `PAYMENT-RESPONSE`.

Error.description: An error; `x-onyx-error-codes` lists every code per status.

bad_json.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

bad_json_pointer.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

bad_request.description: A path, query or body the route does not take: unknown or repeated query parameters, bad names, a HEAD carrying ONYX-CONTRIBUTOR.

bad_series_id.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

bad_template.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

bad_url.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

control_characters.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

empty_field.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

field_too_long.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

invalid_payment.description: A payment that does not parse or fails verification; any HEAD carrying PAYMENT-SIGNATURE.

license_id_bad.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

license_id_missing.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

license_id_unexpected.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

not_keyed.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

payload_invalid.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

payload_route.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

personal_contact.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

pointer_without_endpoint.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

proof_not_supported.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

secret_in_url.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

source_url_required.description: A proposal that fails validation (onyx_intake; docs/spec/submissions.md).

payment_failed.description: The settle failed; PAYMENT-RESPONSE says why.

payment_required.description: Pay with x402: the offer is in PAYMENT-REQUIRED.

invalid_contributor_proof.description: The ONYX-CONTRIBUTOR proof does not verify.

label_rights_withheld.description: ONYX_RIGHTS=fallback: label-derived data is withheld until its rights are cleared.

not_a_contributor.description: The proof's address has no accepted contribution.

not_cross_checked.description: The row is not cross-checked by its serving check.

serving_check_failed.description: The serving check refused the shard or row.

serving_check_unavailable.description: The metric's serving check cannot run.

test_labels.description: The shard uses a test.* label set; never served as real data.

track_log_priced.description: A track log holds a level-1 or level-2 value the paid API sells.

track_registry_names_addresses.description: The track registry names an address; never served.

no_label_row.description: The set lists no membership for this address (the server word, not a proof).

no_serving_check.description: No serving check for this metric on this server.

no_shard_at_as_of.description: Every shard of the metric is newer than as_of.

no_signed_report.description: No signed report for this fact.

no_track_record.description: No track record; `reason` is none_published, no_rule or no_record.

not_finalized.description: The shard's root is not final yet.

too_old.description: No settled round at or after min_window_end.

unknown_label_set.description: No salted label set with this content hash.

unknown_subject.description: No row for the subject (the server's word, not a proof of absence).

method_not_allowed.description: Wrong method for the route; `Allow` names the right ones.

commitment_moved.description: `at` is not the latest commitment: fetch the record again.

level3_not_servable.description: The signed fact is not servable now; `reason` says why.

payment_in_use.description: This authorization already has an open settle for another request.

proof_level_not_accepted.description: The market's shard is at a level its policy refuses.

root_mismatch.description: The pinned ?root= is not the shard's final root.

settled_value.description: The fact settled a value: ask /v1/observations with outcome=all.

unknown_commitment.description: `since` names no commitment of the server's chain.

body_too_large.description: A submission is at most 64 KiB.

export_too_large.description: The export passes the row or byte cap.

track_log_too_large.description: The log passes the row or check budget.

refused.description: The proposal cannot be taken; `route` says why.

daily_quota.description: The daily submission or check quota is used up.

payer_busy.description: The payer has 4 unsettled payments waiting; retry after 60 s.

payer_limited.description: Too many payments from this payer; see Retry-After.

rate_limited.description: Too many requests from this client; see Retry-After.

binding_mismatch.description: The shard's binding differs from the ledger's; nothing served.

catalog_mismatch.description: The catalog entry does not match the shard; nothing served.

rows_mismatch.description: Stored rows do not hash to the root; nothing served.

clock_skew.description: The server's clock is more than 300 s off the chain's.

contributor_checks_busy.description: Contributor checks are busy; see Retry-After.

facilitator_busy.description: The facilitator is busy; see Retry-After.

facilitator_unavailable.description: The payment facilitator cannot be reached.

intake_busy.description: Too many submission writes in flight.

intake_full.description: The journal holds its maximum number of submissions.

intake_unavailable.description: The submission journal cannot be read or written.

level3_chain_unavailable.description: No finalized block can be read.

level3_clock_skew.description: A time in the post log is more than 300 s ahead of this server's clock.

level3_posts_delayed.description: A level-3 post has been pending more than 600 s.

level3_store_unreadable.description: The level-3 post log cannot be read.

overloaded.description: Too many requests in flight; retry in 1 s.

payment_pending.description: Self-settle: retry the same request; it is served once the transfer is proven.

receipt_log_unavailable.description: The receipt log cannot be written; new payments refused, nothing charged.

root_source_unavailable.description: The root source cannot be read.

serving_check_pending.description: The serving check has not judged the current root yet.

settle_intent_unavailable.description: The settle intent log cannot be written.

track_store_unreadable.description: The track publication file cannot be read or checked.

prepaid_not_offered.description: An ONYX-PREPAID-VOUCHER header on a server that takes x402 payments only.

invalid_prepaid.description: An ONYX-PREPAID-VOUCHER header that does not parse.

prepaid_refused.description: A voucher that is not the buyer's, does not add exactly the price to the last total (`last` and `price` say what to sign), exceeds the deposit, or comes while an exit is pending. Nothing was served or charged.

prepaid_unavailable.description: The server cannot read the buyer's account or record prepaid usage durably; nothing was charged.

observe_payment_required.description: No round settled this level-2 subject yet; `observe` offers one for a prepaid hold (price, deadline, that the value becomes public, the refund rule).

unknown_ticket.description: No such paid observation ticket on this server.

bad_want_signature.description: The signature is not the buyer's over this week's want text.

bad_want_value.description: A want's value is not in its closed list.

bounty_too_specific.description: A want with anything but the four closed-list values (free text, a URL, a metric, a subject, a date), or extra fields beside want, buyer and signature.

chain_unavailable.description: The prepaid account could not be read on chain.

journal_unavailable.description: The want could not be written to the node's journal.

no_prepaid_account.description: Only an open prepaid deposit may post a want.

too_many_wants.description: An account holds at most 16 live wants.

wants_closed.description: This node has no prepaid contract, so it takes no wants (the board is still shown).
